en.title: The Sound of Turning Pages in the City That Never Sleeps
en.premise: In a second-hand bookstore tucked away from the bustle of the city that never sleeps, an old book of poetry arrives. Tucked within its pages are several mysterious bookmarks, their purpose and origin a complete enigma. As I trace the 'fragments of the city' pointed out by these bookmarks, I begin to follow the trail of a long-lost goodwill. It is a story akin to an undelivered letter—a message left by one soul for another.

zh.title: 不夜城的翻页声
zh.premise: 在一家仿佛为了躲避不夜城喧嚣而静静伫立的旧书店里，一本古老的诗集悄然送达。书页间夹着几枚意义不明的神秘书签，让人无法窥见原主人的意图。我开始循着书签所指引的“城市碎片”，追寻那份曾经寄托其中的善意的去向。这是一个如同某人留给某人、却始终未能送达的信笺般的故事。
